title: GNO Embed Receipt
description: Receipt emitted by `gno embed --json` for a run that reached a result (failures emit the error envelope instead). A dry run reports the pending chunk count as `embedded` and omits `remaining`. A run that embeds adds `remaining`; a run ended by `--max-chunks` or `--max-seconds` with work pending adds `stopped`.

embedded.description: Chunks embedded and stored by this run; for `--dry-run`, the chunks that would be embedded.

errors.description: Chunks that failed to embed in this run; they stay pending.

contentionErrors.description: Chunks deferred by SQLITE_BUSY/LOCKED - not embedding failures.

searchAvailable.description: False when sqlite-vec is unavailable: vectors are stored but KNN search is disabled.

errorSamples.description: Up to a few distinct failure messages.

suggestion.description: Next step for the user, when one applies.

syncError.description: Vector index sync failure after embedding.

remaining.description: Chunks still pending for the scope after this run (0 when the backlog is done). Present on runs that embed, absent on `--dry-run`.

stopped.description: A run limit (`--max-chunks` or `--max-seconds`) ended the run with work pending. Absent otherwise.

incomplete.description: The run ended early because the embedding runtime changed. Absent otherwise.

then.description: A limit stop leaves work pending and is never a runtime change.
